summary: SES S.A. furnished a 6-K with two press releases dated September 23, 2026: an interim dividend of EUR 0.25 per A-share (EUR 0.10 per B-share) payable October 15, 2026, part of a commitment to at least EUR 0.50 total FY2026 dividend, with a final dividend of at least EUR 0.25 per A-share expected May 2027 subject to results and shareholder approval; and the board appointment of Michel Scholer, Luxembourg Government Secretary General. The filing is a routine shareholder-return and governance update, not a special situation. Watch payout confirmation and any revision to the final dividend target.
